answer: A single Blacksmith anvil mark registered with the smiths guild does the work of a whole committee: each mark is an anvil struck and registered by the smiths guild, so a farm must, verified by a stranger. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 479 fakes need 479, at 107 POA each, totalling 51253 POA. Without a gale there is no proof, without a fable there is no deterrent, and without a bridge there is no audit. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
